sampling.deviation_from_card: presence_penalty 0.0 instead of the card's 1.5 for thinking mode. The penalty subtracts 1.5 from the logit of every token already in the output, which penalizes the repeated tokens meow_between_words, end_of_sentence and repeat_sentences require and favors unused case variants in the case modes, so compliance would partly measure the sampler, and the other exp03 models run at 0.0. With it at 0.0 the settings equal Qwen3.6's card. Risk: more repetition loops in small models; degenerate and truncated shares are reported next to compliance.

analysis: cc_survival.py, the same outcomes as the manifest (primary S(1000) macro over the 7 abortable modes; reached-t*, P1, P2 judge, accuracy on full traces). The 6 contrasts per outcome (2 models x 3 Arun prompts vs baseline) are Holm-corrected as their own family (cfg.HOLM_FAMILY); the manifest's 9 pre-registered contrasts keep their own correction. Not pooled with exp02 (exp02 has no Qwen3.5 data).
